headline: Drake has been Spotify’s most-streamed rapper for 18 months straight 🤯🔥 He earned 1.75 B
body:
Drake has been Spotify’s most-streamed rapper for 18 months straight 🤯🔥

He earned 1.75 BILLION streams in August alone, bringing his total for the year to 14.5 BILLION 🦉

What Drake song have you had on repeat lately? 👇

📸: Getty Images
